The ranking is unstable and several correlated groups exist; a weighted combination based on inverse error may exploit the top performers while still being robust.
The series shows strong trend/seasonality and unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models while keeping most pool.
test a different weighting method (softmax_neg_error) to see if a probabilistic weighting improves over inverse_error.
The ranking is unstable and several correlated groups exist; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting may capture complementary strengths across horizons.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust median might improve over mean/weighted.
The ranking is unstable and we have a small, high‑variance pool (pool4). A robust DBA on this subset may outperform mean/median.
The ranking is unstable and robust methods may help; test a DBA over the full pool to see if expanding the pool improves robustness.

test robust median on stable pool

decision.justification: Selected 'dba on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9555. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.002); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.305.
